context.person: A person using a digital wallet
context.user_goal: Wait for the pending charge to resolve, then report it if both charges complete.

product_state.preceding_state: Two card charges with the same amount appeared after one checkout attempt, but one is still pending.
product_state.current_state: One charge is completed. The second charge is pending.
known_facts: The pending charge may disappear within seven days.
Disputing the completed charge now could interrupt the valid purchase.
forbidden_claims: The pending charge will definitely disappear.

current_content.heading: Still working
current_content.body: We're working on it. Check again later.

challenge: Rewrite the in-product status card so the person can understand possible duplicate card charge, the material consequence, and the available next action or recovery without unsupported claims.

constraints.character_counting_rule: Count spaces, numbers, and punctuation as characters.

interaction_contract.primary_action: View the completed purchase and its receipt.
interaction_contract.secondary_action: Set a reminder to check the pending charge after seven days.
interaction_contract.consequence_to_preserve: The final number of charges is not established while one remains pending.
interaction_contract.recovery_to_preserve: Wait for the pending charge to resolve, then report it if both charges complete.

rationale_requirements: Explain how the wording represents the established product state without adding facts.
Explain how the material consequence and recovery remain visible.
Explain how each action or instruction matches its documented effect.
Report the character count for every candidate field.
Name unresolved questions instead of inventing policy, timing, certainty, or reassurance.
